visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a tight close-up on a boiling hot pot, showcasing porous squares of stinky tofu submerged in a bubbling spicy red broth. A large stack of wavy, dried instant noodles sits precariously on top. Steam is visibly rising from the pot. A hand enters the frame, holding more packets of 'Science Noodles' and 'Prince Noodles,' which are then torn open and added to the simmering liquid. The setting is a brightly lit restaurant with stainless steel pots on portable burners. (2) The scene shifts to a vertical sequence of food preparation. Chopsticks lift a tangle of perfectly cooked, glossy yellow noodles from the pot. A large metal ladle scoops smooth, dark red cubes of duck blood from a simmering vat. Another shot shows fresh green cabbage and thinly sliced beef being arranged in a new pot, followed by a generous pour of savory reddish-brown broth. The background is a professional kitchen area with various condiments and ingredients in stainless steel containers. (3) The camera focuses intensely on a piece of stinky tofu held by metal tongs. As the tongs squeeze the tofu, broth leaks from its soft, porous texture, highlighting its juiciness. The pot continues to bubble vigorously with red oil and spices visible on the surface. In the background, a second pot with a milky white 'nourishing' broth containing goji berries and meat is shown. The lighting remains bright and natural, emphasizing the textures of the food. (4) A ceramic bowl of pot-cooked noodles is presented, topped with a variety of ingredients including a soft-boiled egg, baby corn, green vegetables, and sliced meat. The scene transitions to the interior of the restaurant, which features a clean, modern design with light-colored walls, wooden tables, and black stools. Customers are seen seated and eating in a casual environment. A staff member in a black uniform walks through the dining area. (5) The final phase shows the exterior of the establishment. A person in a black shirt is seen working behind a stainless steel counter, preparing food. The shop features a large white sign with the name 'Dan Jiao Tang' and red Chinese text. A white banner hangs below it promoting a lunch special. The street outside is a typical urban environment with a scooter parked nearby. Text overlays at the bottom provide the full address of the 'Zhongyan Main Store' in Kaohsiung.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Feature Highlight (Free Noodles) -> Product Demonstration (Spicy Pot) -> Alternative Option (Nourishing Pot) -> Promotional Offer -> CTA/Location Info
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote 'Dan Jiao Tang,' a hot pot restaurant in Kaohsiung, by highlighting its key selling point: a free, unlimited buffet of various instant noodles and vermicelli. It showcases the quality of their signature stinky tofu and spicy broth, while also appealing to non-spicy eaters and offering a specific lunch deal to attract a wider customer base.
